name: Outbound webhooks
description: Sends ProPR events (pull requests opened, reviews scored, Ultrafix runs ended, pull requests merged or closed, task progress, epic queue blocked or completed) as signed JSON to any HTTPS endpoint. The generic integration for services without a plugin of their own.

connections.name: target-1-secret
connections.label: Target 1 signing secret
connections.help: A random secret of at least 32 characters, also configured on the receiving endpoint. Every delivery to target 1 is signed with it (HMAC-SHA256 in the X-ProPR-Signature header); without it nothing is sent to target 1.

connections.name: target-2-secret
connections.label: Target 2 signing secret
connections.help: A random secret of at least 32 characters, also configured on the receiving endpoint. Every delivery to target 2 is signed with it (HMAC-SHA256 in the X-ProPR-Signature header); without it nothing is sent to target 2.

connections.name: target-3-secret
connections.label: Target 3 signing secret
connections.help: A random secret of at least 32 characters, also configured on the receiving endpoint. Every delivery to target 3 is signed with it (HMAC-SHA256 in the X-ProPR-Signature header); without it nothing is sent to target 3.

target1Url.label: Target 1 URL
target1Url.help: The https:// endpoint that receives the events, such as https://hooks.example.com/propr. It must be a public host name; private addresses and plain HTTP are refused.

target1Events.label: Target 1 events
target1Events.help: The events sent to target 1. Unselected events are not sent.

target1Repositories.label: Target 1 repositories
target1Repositories.help: Only events of these repositories (owner/repo) are sent to target 1. Leave empty for every repository the plugin is enabled for.

target2Url.label: Target 2 URL
target2Url.help: The https:// endpoint that receives the events, such as https://hooks.example.com/propr. It must be a public host name; private addresses and plain HTTP are refused. Leave empty to not use this target.

target2Repositories.label: Target 2 repositories
target2Repositories.help: Only events of these repositories (owner/repo) are sent to target 2. Leave empty for every repository the plugin is enabled for.
